**Finding submitted — deviation (NOSOLICIT), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** Article X(b) (p0125) is the only non-solicit in the document (confirmed by searches for solicit/employ/hire/recruit/induce); Article XI (p0126–p0127) only cross-refers to it for injunctive relief.
- **Why it fails fallback/walk-away:** one-way against Licensee, three years post-termination (>24 months), and covering every person employed by Licensor **and its Affiliates** (all Vendor personnel).
- **Already met and preserved verbatim:** the retained "Solicit" definition carves out general job advertising and responses/voluntary inquiries, and restricts only affirmative recruitment — no no-hire ban.
- **Cure:** one surgical replace making the covenant mutual, limiting it to personnel directly involved in performing services under the Agreement, and cutting the term to 12 months from the end of that involvement. We stayed at fallback rather than deleting the clause, which would leave Article XI's reference to the "Non Solicitation of Licensor Employees" dangling.
